what: Give the Settings row 'Backup and restore' a short grey status line: 'Kept safe in your MettleUp account' or 'Only on this phone'
why: Every other main Settings row already says how it is set (units, rest, reminders), but the one row that answers 'is my data safe?' says nothing; a phone-only member has to open the page to find out
impact_why: Most members train with no account, so their history lives on one phone; seeing it on the row is the cheapest nudge to sign in
my_view: My view: do it; the app already knows whether the member is signed in (the Workout tab's 'only on this phone' card reads the same thing), so this is one line on the existing row list.

what: Show 'New reply from the MettleUp team' as the grey line on Settings, Help and feedback, when a reply is unread
why: The unread count shows only on the round button and the workout top-bar button; a member who switched the round button off and opens Settings sees no sign of the reply
impact_why: Only members with an open question, but those are the members most likely to leave if they feel ignored
my_view: My view: do it; the unread count is already worked out for the button, so the row only has to read it.

what: Let the member answer the team's reply inside the same question ('Reply' under the team's message), instead of only 'Ask something new'
why: Today the conversation view ends with one button that starts a fresh, unlinked question; a member answering 'which phone do you have?' starts a new thread and the team loses the context
impact_why: Every help question that needs one more answer from the member; support time doubles when threads split
my_view: My view: do it, but after the 30-day / one-phone limit on replies is settled (FN-L14-phone-components-2-01), since a reply thread that vanishes after 30 days is worse than none. In-app help chats such as Intercom's work this way (as known by Jun 2026, not re-checked live).

what: Do not add a screenshot attachment to Help and feedback for now
why: A picture would help the team see a bug, but a screenshot of a workout or profile carries body numbers and photos to our server, against the 'stays on your phone' promise; the message already carries the screen name and app version
impact_why: Saves building and a privacy-notice change for a gain nobody has asked for yet
my_view: My view: skip it until the team finds replies blocked for want of a picture; the screen name plus the watch log switch already cover most bug reports.

what: Give the shared empty-state piece an optional action button, and use it where the next step is obvious ('No sets logged yet' -> 'Add to a workout', 'Exercise not found' -> 'Back to exercises', 'No photos yet' -> 'Take a photo')
why: The empty state draws only an icon, a title and a line; on many screens the line tells the member what to do but gives no button, so they must go and find it
impact_why: The empty screens are what a new member sees in the first week, the week that decides whether they stay
my_view: My view: do it; one optional part on a piece used in about 47 places, then add the button screen by screen where it saves a tap. Leave search-result empties alone.

what: In Settings, Your gym: add 'Invite a friend to <gym>' when the member has a gym, and 'Recommend MettleUp to my gym' when they have none
why: Both growth actions already exist (Gym tab and the welcome slides) but Settings, Your gym offers only Join or Leave; a member looking in Settings for how to bring a friend finds nothing
impact_why: Each invite lands in the gym's enquiries marked as a referral, the one loop that brings paying gyms new members
my_view: My view: do it; both share messages are built, so these are two rows that open what exists. Keep the group at most 7 rows.

what: Ask for a Google Play rating at a happy moment (for example the 5th finished workout or a new personal best), using Play's own in-app review card
why: The app has no rating ask at all and no 'Rate MettleUp' row; store ratings decide whether a gym member who hears of the app installs it
impact_why: Store rating and review count are the first thing a new member sees on the listing; Hevy and Strong both ask in-app (as known by Jun 2026, not re-checked live)
my_view: My view: do it, but never after a help question or a failed save; once per member per few months, and Play decides whether to show it. Needs one small native library, so it rides the next release.

items.reason: 7 improvement rows IM-L18-phone-components-2-01..07; ideas that repeat existing findings (age never grows, number change not reaching gym, replies kept 30 days, photo backup switch) skipped; store listing and website conversion belong to the store and website areas
every row is a My view: proposal; nothing built
